examples.chinese: 他送我花和一本書。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ huā hé yì běn shū.
examples.english: He gave me flowers and a book as presents.

examples.chinese: 我想買兩本中文書、一本英文書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, yì běn Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: I want to buy two books in Chinese and a book in English.

examples.chinese: 友美愛看書，我想送她兩本中文書，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.chinese: 這本書八十元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bāshí yuán.
examples.english: This book costs eighty dollars.

examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 我是日本人，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Rìběn rén, nǐ ne?
examples.english: I am from Japan. How about you?

examples.chinese: 我知道，她是日本人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, tā shì Rìběn rén.
examples.english: Yes, I do. She is from Japan.

examples.chinese: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
examples.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

examples.chinese: 這本書很不錯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn búcuò.
examples.english: This book is not bad.

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

items.wordHook: a 木(tree) presses a 一(one) sheet flat → 本(book).

examples.chinese: 你喜歡山上的風景還是海邊的風景？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shānshàng de fēngjǐng háishì hǎibiān de fēngjǐng?
examples.english: Do you like the scenery on the mountain or on the beach?

examples.chinese: 你要果汁還是牛奶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào guǒzhī háishì niúnǎi?
examples.english: Do you want juice or milk?

examples.chinese: 你要喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: What do you want to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 我們要怎麼去？坐捷運還是坐公車？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù? Zuò jiéyùn háishì zuò gōngchē?
examples.english: How do we get there? By MRT or bus?

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

items.wordHook: a 辶(walking) traveler circles a 睘(round) track and comes back for one more lap → 還(also).

examples.chinese: 那麼我們現在去找他。
examples.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Let’s go ask him now.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡夏天到鄉下去住幾天，那裡比都市涼快多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xiàtiān dào xiāngxia qù zhù jǐ tiān, nàlǐ bǐ dūshì liángkuai duō le.
examples.english: I like to go to the countryside to stay for a few days in summer; it is much more pleasantly cool there than in the city.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹不但長得漂亮，身高也夠高，十六歲就有人找她演戲了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei bùdàn zhǎng de piàoliang, shēngāo yě gòu gāo, shíliù suì jiù yǒu rén zhǎo tā yǎnxì le.
examples.english: My younger sister is not only pretty, but also tall enough; by the time she was sixteen, someone had already asked her to act.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

items.wordHook: Combining 演(perform) and 戲(play): 演戲 means play in a drama.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
examples.pinyin: Gānggāng dàjiā tuīlái tuīqù de, jiéguǒ bǎ píngzi gěi dǎpò le, zhè suàn shéi de cuò?
examples.english: Just now everyone was pushing it back and forth, and as a result the bottle got broken—whose fault is this considered to be?

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ wèi xuéshēng de qīzhōngkǎo méi kǎo hǎo, jiàoshòu yào tāmen xià xīngqī bǔkǎo. Chūmén shàngbān qián, wǒ cái fāxiàn duǎnqún pò le, bùdébù xiān bǔ hǎo zài qù shàngbān, jiéguǒ jiù chídào le.
examples.english: Several students didn't do well on the midterm exam, so the professor wants them to take a make-up exam next week. Before going out to work, I discovered that my skirt was torn, and I had no choice but to mend it first before going to work, and as a result, I was late.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 茶樹的葉子沒有被破壞的話，做出來的茶葉品質都比較好。
examples.pinyin: Cháshù de yèzi méiyǒu bèi pòhuài de huà, zuò chūlái de cháyè pǐnzhì dōu bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.english: If the leaves of the tea tree have not been damaged, the quality of the tea leaves produced is generally better.

examples.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 我的裙子破了個洞，還好室友有針和線，幫我補了起來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qúnzi pòle ge dòng, háohǎo shìyǒu yǒu zhēn hé xiàn, bāng wǒ bǔle qǐlái.
examples.english: My skirt had a hole, but luckily my roommate had a needle and thread and helped me mend it.

examples.chinese: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gōngyè ér bùduàn kāifā, zhèyàng xiàqù sēnlín zǎowǎn huì bèi pòhuài guāng de.
examples.english: Developing industry by constantly exploiting resources, if this continues, the forests will sooner or later be completely destroyed.

examples.chinese: 這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn céng yīn zhànzhēng ér bèi pòhuài, rújīn zǒngsuàn chóngxīn kāifàng cānguān.
examples.english: This museum was once destroyed because of war, and nowadays it has finally reopened for visits.

items.wordHook: A heavy sharp 石(stone) striking rough animal 皮(skin) until it tears apart causes a 破(break).

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí wǒ xǐhuān yí ge rén mànmàn kàn, bú tài xǐhuān diànyuán yìzhí xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo.
examples.english: When shopping, I like to look around slowly by myself; I don't really like salesclerks constantly trying to sell to me.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

examples.chinese: 這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì yīnwèi gōnggòng shèbèi tài jiù, gòuwù yě bù fāngbiàn, bùshǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le.
examples.english: Because this ancient city's public facilities are too old and shopping is also inconvenient, quite a few people have moved away.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 購物時不能只看包裝，品質才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí bùnéng zhǐ kàn bāozhuāng, pǐnzhì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: When shopping, you can't just look at the packaging; quality is what's most important.

examples.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
examples.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

examples.chinese: 拿到購物收據，要是發現算錯帳了，就請店員再算一次。
examples.pinyin: Ná dào gòuwù shōujù, yàoshi fāxiàn suàn cuò zhàng le, jiù qǐng diànyuán zài suàn yí cì.
examples.english: When you get the shopping receipt, if you find that the bill has been calculated wrong, ask the clerk to calculate it again.

examples.chinese: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu, chāoguò gèrén xūqiú de xiāofèi, què zhǐ huì dàilái fánnǎo.
examples.english: Shopping is a kind of enjoyment, but spending that exceeds personal needs only brings worries.

examples.chinese: 很多人購物不在乎商品的品牌，只要耐用就好。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō rén gòuwù bù zàihu shāngpǐn de pǐnpái, zhǐyào nàiyòng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: Many people don't care about the brand of a product when shopping; as long as it's durable, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎoshǔ guīdìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng sùjiāodài hòu, shǐyòng gòuwùdài de rén jiù jiànjiàn zēngjiā le.
examples.english: After the Environmental Protection Administration banned the use of plastic bags, the number of people using shopping bags gradually increased.

examples.chinese: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎnglù fādá, xiàndài rén dàdōu xíguàn shàngwǎng gòuwù.
examples.english: Due to the development of the Internet, modern people for the most part are accustomed to shopping online.

examples.chinese: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù gòuwù bànlǐ tuìhuò shí, bìxū bǎochí shāngpǐn yuánlái de wàiguān cái xíng.
examples.english: When returning items purchased online, you must keep the product's original appearance.

items.wordHook: Browsing bustling markets to 購(buy) and acquire each needed 物(thing): 購物 means go shopping.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 公司的工作須知訂得非常詳細，不過從來沒有員工仔細看完。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de gōngzuò xūzhī dìng de fēicháng xiángxì, bùguò cónglái méiyǒu yuángōng zǐxì kàn wán.
examples.english: The company's work guidelines are set out in great detail, but no employee has ever read them carefully all the way through.

items.wordHook: Combining 詳(complete) and 細(fine): 詳細 means detailed.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.
examples.english: That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.
examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 有人花大半輩子的時間工作，陪親人的時間卻非常少。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén huā dàbàn bèizi de shíjiān gōngzuò, péi qīnrén de shíjiān què fēicháng shǎo.
examples.english: Some people spend more than half their lifetime working, yet the time they spend with their family is very little.

examples.chinese: 他對自己很小氣，可是對朋友卻很大方。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ hěn xiǎoqì, kěshì duì péngyǒu què hěn dàfāng.
examples.english: He is very stingy with himself, but he is very generous with friends.

examples.chinese: 想找吃喝玩樂的朋友不難，想有一位知心的朋友卻不容易。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng zhǎo chī hē wánlè de péngyou bù nán, xiǎng yǒu yí wèi zhīxīn de péngyou què bù róngyì.
examples.english: Finding friends to eat, drink, and have fun with is not hard, but wanting to have an intimate friend is not easy.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu, chāoguò gèrén xūqiú de xiāofèi, què zhǐ huì dàilái fánnǎo.
examples.english: Shopping is a kind of enjoyment, but spending that exceeds personal needs only brings worries.

examples.chinese: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān, suàn qǐlái cái sān ge yuè éryǐ, què yǐ qùguo shí jǐ jiā cháguǎn le.
examples.english: In total, it has only been three months since I came to Taiwan, yet I have already been to more than ten tea houses.

examples.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
examples.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
examples.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

examples.chinese: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐqián huàxué chéngjī cháng bù jígé, méi xiǎngdào xiànzài què shì yǒumíng de huàxué jiàoshòu.
examples.english: He used to often fail chemistry, but unexpectedly now he is a famous chemistry professor.

examples.chinese: 我雖然尊敬他，卻不認同他所堅持的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán zūnjìng tā, què bù rèntóng tā suǒ jiānchí de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Although I respect him, I do not approve of the viewpoint he insists on.

examples.chinese: 有人說好看的人像花瓶，好看卻沒有用，這句話我完全不同意。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō hǎokàn de rén xiàng huāpíng, hǎokàn què méiyǒu yòng, zhè jù huà wǒ wánquán bù tóngyì.
examples.english: Some people say that good-looking people are like flower vases—good-looking but useless; I completely disagree with this statement.

examples.chinese: 自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
examples.pinyin: Zìshā huòxǔ néng lìng gèrén bú zài shòudào tòngkǔ, dàn què bǎ tòngkǔ liú gěi le shēnbiān de rén.
examples.english: Suicide may be able to make the individual no longer suffer pain, but it leaves the pain to the people around them.

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

examples.chinese: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xǔduō bànfǎ qù dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo, què háishì dé bú dào zhǔguǎn de zhīchí.
examples.english: I thought of many ways to achieve the company's goal, but still couldn't get the supervisor's support.

examples.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 這輛車雖然是從美國進口，但零件卻是在越南生產的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē suīrán shì cóng Měiguó jìnkǒu, dàn língjiàn què shì zài Yuènán shēngchǎn de.
examples.english: Although this car is imported from the US, its parts are actually produced in Vietnam.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā shīyè le, dàn qīzi sān rén què réng zài yīpáng zhīchí zhe tā, ràng tā ānxīn le bùshǎo.
examples.english: He lost his job, but his wife and three children still supported him on the side, which made him feel much more at ease.

examples.chinese: 父母總是捨得給孩子最好的，卻捨不得對自己好一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì shědé gěi háizi zuì hǎo de, què shěbudé duì zìjǐ hǎo yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: Parents are always willing to give their children the best, yet they can't bear to treat themselves a little better.

examples.chinese: 戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng suīrán shènglì le, zhè ge guójiā què yě shīqù le xǔduō bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Although the war was won, this country also lost many precious lives.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng hǎiyáng yíyàng, zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rénmen cái néng dǐdá hǎi de lìng yì biān.
examples.english: Life is like the ocean; only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

examples.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

items.wordHook: Combining 抵(resist) and 達(reach): 抵達 means arrive.

examples.chinese: 想找吃喝玩樂的朋友不難，想有一位知心的朋友卻不容易。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng zhǎo chī hē wánlè de péngyou bù nán, xiǎng yǒu yí wèi zhīxīn de péngyou què bù róngyì.
examples.english: Finding friends to eat, drink, and have fun with is not hard, but wanting to have an intimate friend is not easy.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 你正好說出了我的心裡話，真是我的知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhènghǎo shuōchū le wǒ de xīnlihuà, zhēn shì wǒ de zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: You happened to say exactly what's in my heart; you are truly my close friend.

examples.chinese: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì bàogào gěi lǎoshī qián zuìhǎo quèrèn yīxià dìzhǐ, wànyī lǎoshī méi shōudào, dào shí nǐ jiù máfan le.
examples.english: Before you mail the report to the teacher, you'd better confirm the address; if the teacher doesn't receive it, you'll be in trouble when the moment comes.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngtái bàogào yǐqián yào bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, yǐmiǎn dào shíhou shǒumángjiǎoluàn de.
examples.english: Before going on stage to give a report, you need to prepare your materials well, so that you won't be in a rush and confused when the time comes.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài zhe yāoqǐngkǎ gěi ménkǒu de fúwù rényuán jiǎnchá, cái néng rùchǎng cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: You bring your invitation card for the service staff at the entrance to check, and only then can you enter the venue to participate in the event.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.chinese: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
examples.pinyin: Zhì biāoqiāng, shèjiàn, kāiqiāng xūyào de jìqiǎo dōu bùtóng, xiǎng shúliàn jiù děi duō liànxí.
examples.english: The skills required for javelin throwing, archery, and shooting a gun are all different; if you want to become proficient, you must practice more.

items.wordHook: A beloved elder 女(woman) in the family who preserves revered 古(old) traditions is your 姑(father sister).
Steeling your heart to 忍(endure) hardship and 耐(resist) pain: 忍耐 means tolerate.
A splash of slick 氵(water) spilled across a smooth polished 骨(bone) causes feet to suddenly 滑(slip).
Combining 生(birth) and 產(give birth): 生產 means produce.
a 禾(grain) sheaf rests by the 斗(measuring cup) → one subject 科(section).
a 口(mouth) shouts 止(stop) as 包(wrap) bundles legs → 跑(run).
One quick 辶(movement) with a 斤(axe) reaches a target standing right 近(near) to you.
A wealthy 人(person) serves the 王(king) beneath gleaming 丷(horns) of bright treasure → 金(gold).
餐(meal) + 廳(hall) → the meal hall: 餐廳(restaurant).
Soot rests above the 灬(fire) of the stove → everything turns 黑(black).
